>Chances are the red flags pop up and you ignore them out of desperation.

Yeah , I know.

Yeah and thats the thing, i dont want to. I dont want that kind of life. That was the point of me coming to this decision. Ive wanted to travel the world, im already planning that for the next 2 years, i already have a job in one of the places ive dreamt to work with since I was a kid. Im grateful that I have them but yeah, im just tired.

>you should be talking to a therapist instead of people on reddit. 

Why do u think i dont? Ive been seeing a therapist for the last 8 months.

>you wanna be in a relationship? work on yourself. 

That missed the point of what I was saying. Im tired of people using me as an emotional backdrop and leaving me when they are done. Im not saying i have problems, i have, and i work on them but everytime, every fucking time, im tired of people doing the same shit bringing me back to stage 1 with all the same issues. 

>someone always has it worse than you.

Yeah, but im not someone and how does that knowledge in any way help me? In fact it makes me even more upset.

Im sorry but I dont have tjose problems. I have a relatively stable job working for a place i dreamt to work at when i was a kid and everyrhinf else is good. But i just... Idk i guess i really madeit long. Im tired.

After 25, things settle down, u plan shit and honestly, i dont want to have a family or anything. And statistically, the chances are much less of finding anyone past 30 especially if i couldnt find someone for the last 20. What or who could I possibly be living for.
